_note: Test cases for three Radex search features, written against data/search/scenario_names.json (ACR Appropriateness Criteria). Not clinician reviewed. Arrays: sizes (feature B, size-aware matching), multi (feature A, multi-complaint searches), recover (feature C, recovery instead of a dead end; every q here returns mode "none" with the current resolveQuery). Each case: q = the search; expected = array of alternatives, the case passes when ANY alternative is satisfied; forbidden = regex that no shown scenario name may match and, unless forbidden_topics is present, no offered topic name may match (an empty string means nothing is forbidden; "." means nothing at all may be shown); forbidden_topics = optional regex for offered topic names only (empty string: topics are not checked; used where forbidden is a pregnancy lookahead that topic titles cannot satisfy); rationale = one line; current = what resolveQuery returned when this file was built. An alternative may contain: modes (array; result.mode must be one of them; omitted = any mode but "none"), ids (list mode: the FIRST shown scenario id must be one of them; recover mode: at least one suggested scenario id must be one of them), topic_groups (array of arrays; for EVERY group at least one of its topics must be offered), nothing (true: no scenario and no topic may be shown or offered; mode none or an empty recovery screen). Offered topics = guide: result.topic plus result.related; choose: result.topics[].topic; list: the topics of result.scenarios; recover: every topic the recovery screen names or suggests, plus the topics of any suggested scenario. Shown scenario names = list: result.scenarios[].name; recover: names of every suggested scenario; guide and choose: none (a guide shows a whole topic grouped by rating and asserts no single scenario, so forbidden is checked against its topic names only). Extra fields: sizes[].size_mm = the size in mm the matcher should read (null when wording like "subcentimeter" has no single value); gap = true when no ACR range covers the size, so no range scenario may be asserted; honest = true when ACR has nothing and the only acceptable answers are none or an empty recovery screen. The owner rule applies to recovery suggestions too: no wrong body part, no ignored pregnancy/age/negation, no opposite condition, no dropped disease word. See cases.test.mjs beside this file for a reference grader.
